function d({ a } = { a: 1 }, b: number) { return a + b; }
const ar = ([p, q] = [1, 2], s: string) => p + q + s;
class C { m({ k }: { k: number } = { k: 0 }, n: number) { return k + n; } }
function f(x = 1, y: string) { return x.toFixed() + y; }
function g(x: number | undefined = 1) { return x.toFixed(); }
console.log(d(undefined, 2), ar(undefined, "s"), new C().m(undefined, 1), f(undefined, "y"), g());
const bad: (x: number, y: string) => string = f;
